info.title: com.clodhub/opening-hours
info.description: A shop's weekly opening hours in its own time zone: named schedules, the schedule in force, which dates and times can be booked, the wall-clock arithmetic every booking component shares (any IANA zone, correct across daylight saving changes, with Intl.DateTimeFormat only), and the hours as schema.org texts and in words.

methods.description: Whether the value is a time of day from 00:00 to 23:59.

methods.description: The day of the week of a calendar date (0 Sunday to 6 Saturday); the same in every time zone.

methods.name: zonedInstant
methods.description: The instant a wall-clock date and time name in a zone, computed with Intl.DateTimeFormat for any IANA zone and correct on the days the clocks change. As RFC 5545 reads local times, a time skipped when the clocks go forward is read with the offset before the change (02:30 becomes 03:30) and a time that happens twice when they go back is its first occurrence. The time may be 24:00, the end of the day.

methods.name: validateCalendar
methods.description: Every problem with a booking calendar, as text naming where it is; an empty list when it is valid. Checks the time zone, unique schedule ids, the days and windows of each week, by-appointment days that have no windows, and the default schedule.

methods.description: The schedule with this id, or the default schedule when the id is missing or unknown.

methods.name: closedDays
methods.description: The days of the week with no opening window.

methods.description: The first date with an opening window from the earliest bookable date, looking a week ahead; the earliest bookable date when the whole week is closed.

methods.name: checkBooking
methods.description: Whether a booking may start at a date and time, checked in this order: the form of both, the earliest bookable date (and, with no lead days, a start still to come), an open day, a window that holds the start time (open <= time < close).

methods.name: openingHoursSpecification
methods.description: The schema.org openingHours texts of a week, Monday first: days in a row with the same windows share a day range, one text per window ("Tu-Fr 09:30-13:30", "Tu-Fr 16:00-19:30", "Sa 09:00-14:00").

methods.name: describeHours
methods.description: The opening hours in words, Monday first, with the language's short day names: days with the same windows share an entry, three or more days in a row become a range, entries are joined by " | " ("Tue–Fri: 09:30–13:30, 16:00–19:30 | Sat: 09:00–14:00"). Days open by appointment show `byAppointment`, closed days show `closed`, and days without such a text are left out. French puts a no-break space before the colon.

methods.name: settingsFrom
methods.description: Converts and checks settings given as numbers or as rendered template text; unset and unrendered values take the defaults (DEFAULT_SETTINGS).

methods.name: installedSettings
methods.description: The settings clod rendered at install, converted by settingsFrom.

methods.name: createActiveSchedule
methods.description: Which schedule of the calendar is in force. With a records store the choice is kept in the settings collection, so every server process sees it; without one it is kept by the returned object. A missing, unknown or unreadable choice gives the default schedule.

methods.name: ActiveSchedule.get
methods.description: The schedule in force and when it was chosen.

methods.name: ActiveSchedule.set
methods.description: Puts a schedule of the calendar in force; an id the calendar does not have is UNKNOWN_SCHEDULE. Errors of the store are thrown.

updatedAt.description: A JavaScript Date; shown here as its ISO 8601 text.

open.description: A time on the shop's wall clock, HH:MM from 00:00 to 23:59.

close.description: HH:MM after open; 24:00 is the end of the day.

Window.description: One opening window of a day: bookings may start from open until before close.

WeekHours.description: Opening windows by day of the week, keys "0" (Sunday) to "6" (Saturday); a missing or empty day is closed. A day's windows are in order and do not overlap.

name.description: The schedule's name by language code.

items.description: A day of the week: 0 Sunday to 6 Saturday.

byAppointmentDays.description: Closed days that are open by prior appointment, outside online booking.

Schedule.description: A named week of opening hours.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone name, such as Europe/Madrid or Australia/Sydney.

defaultSchedule.description: The id of the schedule in force when none is chosen.

BookingCalendar.description: The shop's time zone and its schedules, one of them in force at a time (summer and winter hours).

BookingCheck.description: INVALID_FORMAT: not a YYYY-MM-DD date and an HH:MM time; TOO_SOON: before the earliest bookable date or not in the future; CLOSED_DAY: no window that day; OUTSIDE_HOURS: the time is in no window.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone name, such as Europe/Madrid or Australia/Sydney.

now.description: A function returning the current Date; the clock by default.

language.description: A language code for the day names, such as en or es.

byAppointment.description: What days open by appointment show; without it they count as closed.

closed.description: What closed days show; without it they are left out.

leadDays.description: Whole days between today and the first bookable date: 1 books from tomorrow, 0 from later today.

RawSettings.description: Settings as numbers or as the text clod renders into the settings template; a missing value, or one still in its {{name}} form, takes the default.

records.description: A com.clodhub/records store (optional requirement); the choice is kept in its `settings` collection, document `activeSchedule` (the exported constants SETTINGS_COLLECTION and ACTIVE_SCHEDULE_ID), as com.clodhub/active-schedule. Without one the choice lives in this object only.

now.description: A function returning the current Date; the clock by default.

onError.description: Called with the error when the store cannot be read; console.error by default.

ActiveSchedule.description: The schedule in force, kept in the records store when there is one.

oneOf.description: A JavaScript Date; shown here as its ISO 8601 text.

updatedAt.description: When it was chosen; null for the default.

InvalidArgument.message: RangeError: a date, time, time zone, language or number outside its form (programmer error)

InvalidSettings.message: RangeError: leadDays is not a whole number from 0 to 365

InvalidCalendar.message: RangeError: the booking calendar fails validateCalendar, or its default schedule is missing
